study: Does loosening the trail's decay leash / give let the desk's own entries run for more net profit? Replay of the live code, costed with real SIP spreads.
registered_at: 2026-10-06 17:40 ET, before any replay of these variants
origin: Operator 10/6: opens with real potential were 'stalled by the ratchet stop chase'. Quick look at 80 round trips 10/5-10/6: realized -5.1 bp (median hold 2.9 min); price 15 min after exit +7.9 bp; hold-to-15:50 +30.2 bp. But 9/23-29 said the opposite (hold 30 min -43 bp; every looser trail worse). Two up days, repeated names.
tool: tools/replay_session.py --day D [--set ...] --out /tmp/rp_run/D-VARIANT.json; costed with tools/studies/replay_costing.py (full SIP spread once per round trip)

variants.base: live config as recorded for each day
variants.decay_slow: ai_local_trail_decay_idle_sec=30 (leash steps only after 30 s without a new high)
variants.give_wide: ai_local_trail_give_r=0.25 and ai_local_trail_peak_give_pct=0.7 (twice the room behind the peak)

statistic: net bp per trade per variant, and the per-day difference (variant minus base, net bp per trade), mean over the 6 days with a t across days
pass: a variant EARNS A LIVE A/B (after the cost-arm config freeze ends ~10/15) only if: variant minus base >= +3 bp per trade, t across days >= 2, and it is negative on at most 1 of the 6 days. Otherwise no change. Check n > 0 trades per day per variant first (replays have been vacuous before).
no_retuning: variants and bar fixed here; any other setting is a new pre-registration
caveats: 6 sessions; two of them strong up days
replay fills at the recorded price; spread charged by costing
decay/give interact with the arm-site re-entry cooldown, which the replay runs as live
